what: Behind the big title, a slanted (/) pillar from the logo (14×150, tilted .36rad to the right, rotating .05rad per second) and a floor are set up with three. On first view the floor lights up over .55s, and .16s later the pillar drops from 900 above and stands (expo.out). While the panel passes through the screen the camera orbits the scene by half of .35 turn (±31°), and tilts toward the mouse by .13rad sideways and 26 up and down, .02 per frame. Three types — wire: a curved grid floor (density 48, a ring of radius 35 at center and width 150 dips by 84, a height-20 wave spreading at 290/s every 6 seconds), a sky mesh, and an accent-color wire pillar · points: a point-cloud terrain that rises with distance, a rear vertical dotted line, and a glass pillar · aurora: a noise-curtain aurora sky and mountains, the water reflecting them (mirror camera reflection once every two frames, .6 ripple and .46 blur on waves, reflectivity .55), a glowing pillar and drifting dust. points and aurora add a bloom like the original post-processing — only light above the brightness threshold .82 (softness .25) is spread over 6 mips (4 on phone) and added at .85 strength — plus a light vignette (.4/.5). Pillars are scaled down per type to the original on-screen size (345~370px at 900 height — wire .57, points .5, aurora .55x), and in the points and aurora pillars 240 sparkles rise inside the black glass with a 4s lifetime. Panel edges blend into the background at the original edge ratios (wire sides .2, top .02, bottom .5 / points .2, .07, .4 / aurora .3, .226 (210px), .46, phone sides .25 by .65)

options.look: wire (default, light background) · points (dark background point cloud) · aurora (dark background aurora mountains)
options.turns: Number of turns the camera makes while passing a panel (only half is used), default .35 — 0 keeps it fixed
options.yaw: Mouse left-right tilt (rad), default .13 — at 0 it doesn’t follow the mouse
options.lift: Camera lift from mouse up and down, default 26
options.damping: Mouse follow (fraction of remaining distance per frame), default .02
options.reveal: Duration for the floor and pillars to rise (sec), default .55
options.stagger: Delay from the floor to the next column (sec), default .16
options.drop: Height at which the columns start to fall, default 900 — 0 turns them on in place
options.bloom: Bloom strength, default points·aurora .85 · wire 0 (the original wire scene turns bloom off) — at 0 it draws directly with no post-processing
options.water: Water reflection strength, default aurora .43 · otherwise 0 — at 0 no water plane is placed

use: …
note: If three is missing, the part loads library/_vendor/three@0.174.0/build/three.cjs itself and moves it to window.THREE. Colors are read at attach time: wire uses --kf-accent-text (accent for light backgrounds) and 48% (grid) and 78% (mesh) between --kf-ink and --kf-bg, while points and aurora use --kf-accent and --kf-contrast-bg. The original turns the stage off in automated browsers (navigator.webdriver) and shows a still poster, so the original-side motion-probe can’t measure this motion. Drawing stops when it leaves the panel.
